RADARSAT-2 is Canada's next-generation commercial SAR satellite, the follow-on to RADARSAT-1, launched in 1995. RADARSAT-2 has been designed with significant and powerful technical advancements which include 3m high-resolution imaging, flexibility in selection of polarization, left and right-looking imaging options, superior data storage and more precise measurements of spacecraft position and attitude.
